category_edits.rationale: Test stronger absolute-score supervision across all four category models by increasing the pointwise logistic coefficient from 0.2 to 0.4, retaining pairwise softplus and uniform averaging over nonpadding targets. All architecture, sampling, inference and training settings remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Increase only the pointwise loss coefficient to 0.4. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain consistent without changes.
